# HtmlViewForward 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

</div>


```blitzbasic
HtmlViewForward:Void htmlview:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `htmlview` | In | Int32 | required | The handle from [CreateHtmlView](CreateHtmlView). |

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Goes forward to the page after the current one, after going back. Does nothing at the last page.
